services.title: Full Stack Development
services.body: I design and build responsive, high-performance web applications from the ground up. By focusing on clean user interfaces and seamless user experiences, I turn complex requirements into highly functional, interactive digital products that are easy to maintain and scale.

services.title: Applied AI Integration
services.short: Embedding smart features into modern applications.
services.body: I bridge the gap between traditional software and artificial intelligence by integrating smart capabilities directly into user-facing platforms. From incorporating predictive forecasting models to leveraging modern AI tools, I build practical, intelligent features that solve real-world problems.

services.title: API & Backend Systems
services.body: I develop secure and efficient backend architectures that power modern applications. My focus is on creating clean APIs and structured data flow, ensuring that the frontend and backend communicate flawlessly while maintaining high performance and reliability.

services.title: Autonomous Agents
services.body: I leverage Large Language Models to create autonomous workflows and intelligent agents that can execute tasks independently. By orchestrating these systems, I automate complex processes, enhance application interactivity, and build forward-looking solutions that go beyond basic chat interfaces.

services.title: Cloud & Database Solutions
services.short: Seamless deployments and secure data management.
services.body: I manage relational data, handle schema migrations, and ensure smooth deployments using modern cloud platforms. By utilizing Backend-as-a-Service tools, I streamline infrastructure management, allowing for secure, scalable, and efficient data handling without the overhead of complex server configurations.
